messages:
ada: Heads-up: FP8 kernel enablement on H100/L40S exposed strange perf/accuracy deltas during our tilerefraction tests. Can we centralize notes?

ben: Saw the spike. Looks like a sharp perplexity bump when kv-cache crosses a tile boundary (~seq 6k-8k). Possibly aliasing in the tiling handoff. Repro steps below.

ben: repro command:
```bash
./run_bakeoff --model rwd-13b --quant FP8 --hw H100 --seq 8192 --batch 1 --kv-offset 0
```

carmen: Ran a small matrix: FP8 vs AWQ vs GPTQ on longprefix benchmark
FP8: +0.8% ppl vs float32
AWQ: +0.15% ppl
GPTQ: +0.3% ppl
Pattern: FP8 delta jumps when kv-wrap hits tile boundary.

dave: I captured logs: `kernel_prefetch: aliasing detected at tile 23, fallback to scalar path` then `activation_clamp: applied`. Also saw occasional inf/NaN in attention weights.

ada: @dave nice — can you paste the full log snippet? also which kernel commit?

dave: snippet:
```text
[2026-02-12 14:23:02] kernel_prefetch: aliasing detected tile=23 offs=1536
[2026-02-12 14:23:02] fp8_quantize: scale_adjust=1.03
[2026-02-12 14:23:02] warning: activation_clamp engaged
[2026-02-12 14:23:03] attention_weights: found NaN -> replaced
```
commit: 9a1b2c3 (tiling/kv-handoff)

ben: I started a bisect across tiling heuristics + kv-alignment patches. Initial hypothesis: runqueue reshaping + continuous-batching interaction causes an off-by-one tile index on L40s driver.

ada: @carmen can you try same FP8 run with `--kv-offset 1` and `--tile-shift=auto` and post ppl delta?

carmen: quick result: kv-offset 1 reduced FP8 ppl delta to +0.2%. So offset seems to matter. Filing issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/4929 :bell:

deploy-bot: Canary job finished: fp8-tilerefraction-canary v2 — failed healthchecks on canary-3 (NaN observed), rollback initiated :warning:

ada: ok, plan: (1) hold FP8 auto-enable, (2) bisect kernel commits, (3) add kv-offset guard in runtime to align tiles, (4) add regression test for longprefix > 6k. I'll own the runtime guard PR.

ben: I can take the kernel bisect tomorrow. leave notes in the issue.

carmen: added microbench logs and a minimal repro script to the issue. good to triage. :thumbsup:
